finite_pairs_structure.n_params_source: result/s4/confirm/*/result.json (n_params; identical across seeds and equal to selection.json n_params, asserted)

definitions.boundary_fit_base_rate: boundary pairs (Eq. 6, finite caps) and how many fit by the measured minimum peak (P <= 1024 x cap); share_fit = n_fit / n_pairs
definitions.boundary_errors_by_estimator: per estimator over the boundary pairs: admitted_not_fit = predicted to fit but the measured peak exceeds the cap (false fit); rejected_fit = predicted not to fit but fits (false rejection); correct; accuracy_pct = 100 x correct / n_pairs; baseline errors equal the judge's N2.2 discordant b (c = 0), asserted
definitions.n2_2_discordant_judge: N2.2 discordant counts copied from judge_final (b favours the accounting)
definitions.static_estimate_ratio_by_class: estimate / measured minimum peak over the 744 registry configurations; tied = shared, two_groups, reversible_shared; untied (distinct-parameter) = untied, reversible_untied, wide_single; min, median, max per class
definitions.static_estimate_ratio_overall_range: min and max of the ratio over B1, B2, B3 and all 744 configurations
definitions.persistent_share_selected_finite: share = baseline_bytes / min_peak_bytes at the argmin knob over the distinct configurations selected in the 21 finite cells (42 class-cells, 22 configurations), min and max per class
definitions.persistent_share_unbounded_only: share of the selections that occur only in the unbounded cells
definitions.persistent_share_selected_per_config: the share and its two byte counts for each of the 25 selections
definitions.persistent_share_registry_median: median share per task x class over the 744 registry configurations
definitions.persistent_share_registry_median_range: min and max of the three task medians per class
definitions.remainder_share_registry_range: remainder = 1 - share (activations and transients), min and max over 744
definitions.remainder_share_registry_median: median remainder per task x class over the registry
definitions.remainder_share_registry_median_range: min and max of the six task x class remainder medians
definitions.finite_pairs_structure: the distinct (tied, untied) selected pairs over the 21 finite cells: tied T >= 4, untied T <= 2 (wide_single has T = 1), parameter-count ratio untied / tied, and widths d compared
definitions.confirm_runs_knob: confirmation-run records by training knob (microbatch, checkpointing)
definitions.holm_convention_matches_judge: derived_numbers.holm over the 21 finite cells reproduces judge_final's p_plus_holm, p_minus_holm and p_zero_holm exactly (asserted)
definitions.kws_upper_above_floor_p: the three Speech Commands cells whose upper bound exceeds the floor: unadjusted two-sided p and its 21-cell Holm value, from judge_final
definitions.holm_over_14_pairs_final: post hoc: Holm over the 14 distinct finite pairs instead of the 21 cells, final look, per event family (E_plus = p_plus, E_minus = p_minus, two_sided = p_zero); every pair with adjusted p < 0.05
definitions.pairs_upper_below_floor: distinct finite pairs whose one-sided 95% upper bound U is below the floor
definitions.margin_95_final: t_{0.95, n-1} x SD / sqrt(n) per finite cell at n = 12 (scipy.stats.t.ppf); max_abs_diff_U_minus_mean = largest |(U - mean) - margin| against judge_final
definitions.upper_bound_97_5_post_hoc: post hoc one-sided 97.5% bound per finite cell, mean and SD from each judge file (first look n = 10, final n = 12); count below the floor
definitions.knob_regime: argmin knob of the registry and of the 42 finite class-cells; checkpointing-capable = configurations with a checkpointing measurement (asserted = non-reversible); peak at microbatch 64 without checkpointing (the confirmation knob) / (1024 x cap)
definitions.kws_silence: silence clips (word _silence_) per split; validation clips whose [offset, offset + 16000) overlaps a training clip interval of the same source file; test silence by source prefix
definitions.fp32_knob_equivalence: values copied from the REPORT block (test_fp32_reported): parameter max relative differences after three fp32 updates per optimizer, gradient maxima overall and per task; gradient_max_rel_diff_per_optimizer_selected = the largest logged entry per optimizer (a selection of logged values, no recomputation); test names parsed from test/lb/test_train.py (the log prints dots only), count asserted equal to 'Ran N'
definitions.optimizer_counts_unbounded_6: optimizers of the 6 unbounded class-cells (all 48: optimizer_counts_48)
definitions.runs_before_v4: v3 run records under result/s3/{lrcal,floor,bars}: counts by mode, non-null test_acc, latest end_utc against date_frozen of PREREGISTERED_loopbudget_v4.yaml
